title: Topological entropy, mean dimension, and weakly equivalent flows
summary: In this paper, we mainly revisit a nice theory for topological entropy of weakly equivalent flows, which was originally investigated by Ohno in 1980. We will develop a new approach, being more straightforward and elementary than the measure-theoretic one provided by Ohno, to the theory for weak equivalence of flows, and as a novelty, we study both topological entropy and mean dimension with a highly unified process in relation to such objects.
